feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 16 May 2026 11:13am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 16 May 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle for much of the afternoon before clearing this evening. Light winds settling to become a light to moderate southwesterly, maximum temperature 12°C later.

Dry and bright to start tomorrow then showers will affect the island in the afternoon and evening. Moderate to fresh west or southwest wind and a top temperature of 13°C.


##Outlook##

Dry with bright or sunny spells on Monday, then cloud increasing later ahead of a band of rain overnight into Tuesday, as well as the winds strengthening.
